newsitem.title: USA: Ryder to decide on carrier unit by mid-year.
newsitem.headline: Ryder to decide on carrier unit by mid-year.

text.p: Ryder System Inc said on Monday that it hopes to decide on a course of action for its Automotive Carrier Services unit by mid-year.
The unit was profitable during the first quarter after being restructured during 1996, the company said.
Ryder previously announced it had retained an adviser to help it explore strategic options regarding the carrier unit.
Ryder on Monday reported first-quarter net income of $0.43 per share, compared with $0.13 per share for the same period the year before.
